name: Concentrated discretionary research bets and purchased proprietary data (polling forensics, local knowledge, private polls)
one_line: A human out-reads the crowd on polls, procedure, local sources or Fed signalling, sizes a few large positions and holds to settlement; at the top end buys private data; the venue's largest fortunes and its least repeatable strategy.
maturity: Established as a practice, unproven as a repeatable income: the seven largest politics wallets booked everything in Nov-Dec 2024 and have not traded since; mid-tier survivors earn 1-5% of turnover with extreme concentration
requires_ai: optional; LLM analyst-assist for rule parsing, crosstabs, base rates; human sizes
edge: Unprocessed information plus sizing; political underconfidence and longshot overpricing
capital: $1k-$10k to run; $10k+ before research time pays; $100k+ for private polls
build_time: 0 for the human version; 3-6 weeks solo for the analyst-assist agent
opportunity_size: Midterms: 300+ events, $52M volume, $28M liquidity; House control $952k liquidity; growing into Nov 2026
expected_results: Survivors 4-5% of volume (gopfan2 +$1.58M/26 months); Theo +$85M one-shot; solo guess +2-6%/quarter on a guessed 3-5 point edge
competition: 2024 whales gone; desks price marquee races; state races thin
flag: none for own research; grey multi-account and selling it; prohibited tipped info
validate: Pre-registered ledger, 60-100 calls, CLV > +2c after fees; one $2-4k DIY poll pilot
top_risk: Survivorship and single-event concentration (zxgngl -$3.64M on one fight)
solo_fit_reason: Zero infrastructure and the two best-documented slow biases in the price make it the cheapest strategy to try, but returns rest on one human's domain reading, capital locks for months, the leaderboard evidence is one election's survivors, and nothing in it automates beyond an assist layer.
speed_class: speed-insensitive: edge is reading and sizing over days; waits out the first seconds
results_1k: ledger with money on it; -$25 to +$30/month (guess)
results_5k: $0 to +$200/month (derived from a 3-5 point edge guess)
min_capital: ~$5k; below that research hours outweigh expected profit
capacity_ceiling: ~$100k-$500k solo on the midterm map; eight figures fit one presidential cycle
services: DIY survey panels (Pollfish, Prolific) for private-data pilots
monthly_running_cost: minimum $0-20; comfortable $100-300; plus $2-5k per commissioned poll

open_doubts: No public data on a repeatable solo return; every $1k/$5k/$10k figure derives from a guessed 3-5 point edge.

Interview PnL claims (RememberAmalek ~$300k Mamdani, ~$500k South Korea) do not reconcile with the named wallet's Data API series (+$117k realised in 2025; $25k South Korea redemption; $4,125 Cuomo); other wallets are possible but unverifiable.
Pre-2025 wallet histories in /v2/user-pnl are incomplete (fill and volume counters start in 2025), so KuCoin's $15M MonsieurDimanche and any pre-2025 comparison stay unverified.
Whether anyone runs commissioned polling into the 2026 midterms is unknown; YouGov-grade poll prices are quote-only, so the $100k+ private-data threshold is a guess.
The calibration slopes 1.45 / 1.83 and the politics longshot returns are E4's readings of the papers' tables, not abstract figures.
State-race depth medians depend on the event selection (77-250 events); the House and Senate control books are the only six-figure political books measured.
